investigation_notes.Description: SharePoint recorded a bulk download of 1,120 files from a restricted HR site by Aleksei.Ivanov@globalcorp.ee on 2026-01-31T23:04:12Z. The account is for a Senior Software Developer in Engineering, which does not align with the sensitive payroll/finance/leadership paths accessed, and the volume (~1120 vs a 24-hour baseline of 10) is unusually high. The activity occurred at 01:04 local time in Tallinn (UTC+2), within the 'dead of night' window, and there are no recent events or similar alerts to indicate this is an authorized recurring activity, so this is considered High Priority.
